decisions.statement: Every item in every bag of every location is ruled on rather than a sample.
An indeterminate outcome is compared whole rather than counted.
One item disagreeing answers with that item rather than with a tally.
Neither run compared here is the addon's, so agreement is no sign the addon agrees.
Both runs read one env, so a signal that env lacks leaves the two runs alike.
A run that found a divergence answers a code other than zero.
This answers in one shape, so no second shape can answer a second code.

definition: whether the outcome-only run reaches what the full run reaches, over every item held
